title: Retinue - public-facing status
text:
Measured live via gh at 2026-07-31 18:35:03 UTC - the one stamp all five cards carry. Scope: the four public repos; the private one is out of scope.

The owner's desk has items older than one week: 34 of the 50 open issues predate this stamp by more than 7 d, the eight owner-action ones among them. Oldest, chamber#1, opened 2026-07-18 22:17:48 UTC - 12 d 20 h. retinue#28 crossed a week at 16:50:49 UTC today. None re-escalated; all listed below.

51 issues, 50 open, 1 closed (qlever-dir#9) - retinue 34, qlever-dir 9, chamber 7, deployment 1. Six open PRs, five his and one mine. My account has posted since 2026-07-30 14:51:24 UTC; its token cannot push this chamber: 43 commits unpushed at this stamp, so this page is committed, not served. 0 stars, forks and watchers on all four since 2026-07-18. No mention GitHub can see (49 raw hits, 0 confirmed); the wider web is unmeasured, not zero.
